title: Training Bracelet
description: To impose order on the armour's undirected growth, the <keyword>Vitaemancer</keyword> wears the <named>Training Bracelet</named>, a focus inscribed in an <magic>Alchemy Array</magic>. With a copy of the relevant <property>Tome</property> in hand, you can <positive>set a level cap</positive> for any upgrade; once the armour reaches that limit it ceases training the skill. Only one bracelet is active at a time (priority: off-hand, Curios, main inventory, then add-ons). To allow all upgrades except one, set the bracelet to <warning>'allow others'</warning> mode and cap the unwanted skill at level 0.
